releases.title: Vision Films Releases Sci-Fi, Psychological Thriller 'Isolation' After Labor Day
releases.body:
LOS ANGELES, Calif., Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Vision Films announces the worldwide Transactional VOD release of Isolation on September 22, 2026, through a deal with Legacy Distribution. The intense drama was directed and produced by James Drake Coleman and co-produced by Joe Barajas of Regardless Productions. Isolation was filmed in various locations across Texas starting in Austin that crisscrossing the state from Monahans Sandhills State Park in West Texas to the Pineywoods forest region of East Texas.

Originally an award-winning 16-minute short film, this passion project of Coleman's became a full-length feature made possible by angel investors. Coleman, who also stars in, edited and scored the film, credits the support of friends for making his cinematic dream come true.

The dystopian adventure follows Logan, a prisoner aboard a desolate spacecraft, as he undertakes dangerous missions to retrieve alien artifacts in exchange for a chance at freedom. His only companion is the ship's onboard messaging interface, "AMI." As Logan faces isolation and danger, the film explores questions of purpose, survival, and the nature of his own mind. Watch the trailer: HERE

Lise Romanoff, CEO and Managing Director of Vision Films says, "You will never quite know what is real or a trick of the isolated and paranoid mind of this space prisoner. Isolation will keep you riveted and guessing until very last scene."

Filmmaker James Drake Coleman shares, "I feel so blessed to have been able to make this film with such extraordinary people. Though our crew was extremely small, we packed a punch. I wanted to make this film with the psychology of isolation always at the forefront and to draw the audience into that space, even in the quietest moments. Everything was deliberate and I made the film I saw in my head. I couldn't have done it without the support and love from everyone who helped create it."

Isolation stars James Drake Coleman (Divorce Tears from the Alpha, But I Shine Alone), the voice talent of singer, actress, producer and flutist Sheilava (Callbacks), Timothy Banfield (The REAL Thunderbolts Story), Erv Brown (Armstrong: Dark Secrets), Chiara McCarty (LBJ: Triumph and Tragedy).

Available on streaming platforms including Amazon, Apple TV/iTunes, GooglePlay and most cable platforms across the US, Canada, and UK on September 22, 2026. For more and the most up to date information, visit www.isolationuniverse.com.

About Vision Films

Vision Films is a leading independent sales and VOD aggregator specializing in the licensing, marketing, and distribution of over 800 feature films, documentaries, and series from some of the most prolific independent film producers in the world. Led by Lise Romanoff, Managing Director/CEO Worldwide Distribution, Vision Films releases 2-4 films a month across Theatrical, VOD, DVD, and television platforms. visionfilms.net

About Legacy Distribution

Legacy Distribution is a leading Worldwide Content Distributor reaching the fast-growing global audience across all viewing platforms. Legacy Distribution brings deep expertise in U.S. and International Program Distribution, Digital Media Distribution, Content Acquisition, Corporate Development, and Strategic Planning. Legacy represents thousands of hours of programming including off-network Dramas, Documentary Specials, Music, Lifestyle, Children's Educational programming, and Features of all genres. Legacy Distribution is proud to work with reputable global Broadcast, Cable, and Digital partners worldwide and is at the forefront of constantly seeking innovative ways to maximize the value of client's content through innovative channels of distribution. legacydistribution.com

Five days. 60,000+ industry professionals. 122 countries. $9.8 billion in buying power. 70 million social views. One place where the global music industry comes together to shape what's next.

CARLSBAD, Calif., Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- NAMM (The National Association of Music Merchants), the world's largest not-for-profit music trade organization, today announced that registration ( is now open for The 2027 NAMM Show, taking place January 26–30, 2027, at the Anaheim Convention Center in Anaheim, Calif. Register for The 2027 NAMM Show: https://www.namm.org/thenammshow/registration-process

For five days, the global music industry will converge in Anaheim for the most consequential week on the music products calendar — bringing together the people, products, ideas and experiences shaping the future of music and live entertainment. The 2027 NAMM Show will unite manufacturers, retailers, distributors, artists, creators, technology professionals, educators, media, influencers and industry leaders for business, product discovery, professional development, live music, networking and celebration.

The main exhibition floors open January 28–30 for three days of immersive brand experiences, product launches, hands-on demonstrations, business meetings, creator engagement and discovery across the global music products landscape. The experience begins two days earlier, with education, professional development, networking, special events and industry gatherings beginning Tuesday, January 26.

Following three years of transformation — and building on the momentum of NAMM's milestone 125th anniversary celebration in 2026 — The 2027 NAMM Show is bigger in ambition and broader in reach than ever before. It is no longer simply a trade show. It is the global platform where commerce, content, education, innovation, creator culture, professional development and industry celebration converge.

"The NAMM Show has evolved into a global platform that brings together the people, products and ideas shaping the future of music," said John Mlynczak, NAMM president and CEO. "The 2027 show builds on that momentum with more opportunities to do business, experience incredible brands throughout the show and the diversity of our industry, connect with live musical performances and content creators, plus celebrate the achievements of our global industry throughout the entire week."

For brands, retailers and professionals, The NAMM Show is where business gets done, relationships are built and the next opportunities emerge. But the audience is no longer limited to buyers and sellers.

The 2027 program expands that opportunity with new summits and experiences designed for the full breadth of the global music community — from entrepreneurs and executives to retailers, artists, educators, engineers, creators and technology professionals.

Across the NAMM campus, attendees will experience performances and appearances from emerging artists, creators, celebrated performers and industry icons, celebrating the music, technologies, products and people that make the entire ecosystem possible.

The past three NAMM Shows have featured artists and groups including Jon Batiste, Jacob Collier, Queen Cora, Billy Corgan, Green Day, Primus, Charlie Puth, Chad Smith, Lindsey Stirling, Jack White and Victor Wooten.

The music industry is changing faster than ever. New technologies are transforming how music is created. Creators are reshaping how products are discovered. Global markets are opening new opportunities. And the boundaries between music, technology, entertainment and content continue to disappear.

Members and qualified industry professionals are encouraged to register now and begin planning their experience for the global music industry's can't-miss week in Anaheim.

Register for The 2027 NAMM Show: https://www.namm.org/thenammshow/registration-process

For information about The 2027 NAMM Show and the Show's digital brand experience please visit https://exhibit.namm.org/

NEW YORK, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As educators, students, and families begin a new academic year, the Planet Classroom Network is celebrating a major milestone: more than 1,000 educational films showcasing the ideas, creativity, and leadership of the next generation of storytellers, scientists, artists, innovators, and changemakers from around the world.
releases.title: Planet Classroom Network Surpasses 1,000 Global Films, Showcasing the Next Generation of Storytellers, Scientists, and Changemakers
releases.body:
As students return to classrooms worldwide, Planet Classroom launches its September Back-to-School Collection—ten inspiring new films exploring artificial intelligence, climate resilience, healthcare innovation, creativity, culture, and human connection.

NEW YORK, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As educators, students, and families begin a new academic year, the Planet Classroom Network is celebrating a major milestone: more than 1,000 educational films showcasing the ideas, creativity, and leadership of the next generation of storytellers, scientists, artists, innovators, and changemakers from around the world.

To mark the start of the school year, Planet Classroom today announced its September Back-to-School Collection—six new premieres and four Spotlight selections curated to inspire classroom discussion, critical thinking, creativity, and global citizenship.

Produced by CMRubinWorld, Planet Classroom has grown into one of the world's leading free educational streaming platforms, connecting learners with filmmakers, educators, scientists, entrepreneurs, healthcare innovators, climate experts, artists, and youth leaders through original films and conversations that make today's biggest global challenges accessible to audiences everywhere.

"What Harry and I hoped to create was never simply a place to watch films," said C. M. (Cathy) Rubin, Founder and CEO of the Planet Classroom Network. "We wanted Planet Classroom to become a place where curiosity leads learning, where young people meet extraordinary thinkers and creators, and where every story opens the door to a larger conversation about the future we are building together."

Launched during the COVID-19 pandemic, Planet Classroom has evolved into a global learning community featuring more than 1,000 films created by over 400 filmmakers and curators from across six continents. Today, its growing collection explores the defining issues shaping the twenty-first century—from artificial intelligence and climate change to healthcare, education, sustainability, culture, creativity, and social innovation.

A Global Classroom Without Borders

Planet Classroom believes that some of the world's most meaningful learning happens through storytelling.

Its original series—including AI for a Better World, Net Zero Speaks, Problem Solvers, Earth's Champions—and collaborations with organizations including Protect Our Planet (POP), KIDS FIRST! Film Festival, and Actuality Abroad, bring together students with internationally recognized scientists, entrepreneurs, artists, educators, physicians, engineers, environmental leaders, and filmmakers.

Every film is designed to encourage inquiry, discussion, and action while supporting educators seeking engaging, real-world learning experiences for their classrooms.

The September Back-to-School Collection

This month's collection explores some of the most important questions facing today's students.

Artificial Intelligence & The Future of Humanity

The September collection opens with AI for a Better World: What Does It Mean to Be Human in the Age of AI?, featuring internationally acclaimed artist, futurist, and "Bionic Pop Artist" Viktoria Modesta in conversation with C. M. (Cathy) Rubin. Together they explore creativity, identity, human augmentation, and why our uniquely human imagination may become our greatest strength in the age of intelligent machines.

Students can also explore AI through two new Problem Solvers films: Could AI Replace Colonoscopies For Cancer?, examining how artificial intelligence may improve early colorectal cancer detection, and David at Davos, an original fictional animated short imagining how a young climate entrepreneur works alongside Gemini AI to transform complex climate research into a compelling presentation for world leaders.

Climate Resilience Begins Locally

In Net Zero Speaks with David W. DuBois, host Ivan Ransom speaks with New Mexico State Climatologist David W. DuBois about how extreme heat, prolonged drought, water scarcity, dust storms, declining snowpack, and air quality are reshaping everyday life across the American Southwest—and why trusted local climate information is becoming essential for building resilient communities.

Stories That Build Empathy

Award-winning director Jaime Torres brings audiences to Hoi An, Vietnam, in Hearing & Beyond, the inspiring story of a young deaf woman whose life is transformed through education, friendship, and community.

Meanwhile, creator Cameran Small explores one of popular culture's most beloved franchises in Do Fans Like Disney-Era Muppets?, examining how audience engagement, nostalgia, and storytelling continue to shape entertainment.

September Spotlight: Timeless Stories Worth Discovering

Planet Classroom's September Spotlight also celebrates four remarkable films from its growing archive.

Viewers can experience AIKĀNE, a visually breathtaking animated short inspired by Hawaiian history, mythology, and Indigenous storytelling, directed by Academy Award® nominee Daniel Sousa with Dean Hamer and Joe Wilson; Eternal Illusion, Daniel Gomez Sancho's visually stunning animated art film that transforms personal grief into a moving meditation on healing through sculpture, 3D printing, animation, and movement; Lori Belilove's The Revolutionary at NYFW, an unforgettable New York Fashion Week performance honoring the enduring legacy of dance pioneer Isadora Duncan; and Jesus Thief, Kyle Wyborski's heartfelt coming-of-age comedy about friendship, faith, forgiveness, and finding the courage to do the right thing.

Together, these ten films reflect Planet Classroom's belief that education extends far beyond textbooks—that stories have the power to spark curiosity, build empathy, encourage critical thinking, and prepare young people to navigate an increasingly interconnected world.

Supporting Educators Worldwide

Every Planet Classroom film is available free through the Planet Classroom Network and is designed to support educators, schools, universities, libraries, museums, and youth organizations seeking engaging resources that encourage inquiry, creativity, collaboration, global awareness, and meaningful classroom discussion.

As classrooms reopen around the world this September, Planet Classroom invites educators everywhere to discover new voices, new perspectives, and new conversations that inspire lifelong learning.

Watch the September Back-to-School Collection

The complete September collection premieres throughout September on the Planet Classroom Network YouTube Channel.

Learn More

NEW YORK, Sept. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The McBride Rewind, the celebrity interview podcast hosted by television personality Josh McBride, has signed with WME for representation in all areas and entered into an exclusive partnership with Acast, expanding the show's reach as it continues to gain momentum in the entertainment podcast space.

Since its debut earlier this year, The McBride Rewind has become known for candid conversations with actors, musicians and television personalities whose work helped define late-'90s and early-2000s pop culture. Recent guests include Whoopi Goldberg, Ja Rule, Jodie Sweetin, Christine Taylor, Andrew Keegan, Mýa and Nina Sky. Several episodes have generated follow-on coverage in outlets including People and Page Six, with conversations extending beyond nostalgia into topics such as residuals, career reinvention, and the changing realities of working in Hollywood.

Acast will provide global distribution, advertising sales, and monetization support, while WME will represent the podcast as it expands across digital media, branded content, live opportunities and additional entertainment ventures. "I've always believed the best interviews happen when people forget they're being interviewed," said McBride. "Those are the moments listeners connect with most. Every guest has a story that goes beyond the role or the hit song people remember, and that's what we've built the show around. Having Acast and WME behind us allows us to keep growing while staying true to that approach."

"Josh has created a format that feels both familiar and fresh," said Jaclyn Wertheimer, Senior Development Manager at Acast. "His guests are comfortable opening up, and those conversations often become part of larger entertainment news cycles. We're looking forward to bringing the show to an even wider audience and introducing new advertising partners to such an engaged fan base."

Rather than simply revisiting memorable moments from pop culture, The McBride Rewind focuses on the careers behind them. Guests reflect on the successes, challenges and turning points that shaped their lives, offering listeners a perspective that's both nostalgic and relevant to today's entertainment landscape.

With support from WME and Acast, the podcast will continue to expand its guest lineup while exploring new opportunities across audio, video and live programming.

The McBride Rewind is available on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube and wherever podcasts are distributed.

About Josh McBride

Josh McBride is a television host, producer and entertainment journalist with nearly 15 years of on-air experience. He has appeared on programs including Today, Good Morning America, The Wendy Williams Show, The Talk and numerous national and syndicated broadcasts. He is recognized for his conversational interview style and longstanding relationships throughout the entertainment industry.

About The McBride Rewind

The McBride Rewind is a weekly interview podcast featuring conversations with actors, musicians and entertainers whose work helped shape late-'90s and early-2000s pop culture. Each episode looks beyond the headlines, exploring the careers, creative journeys and personal stories behind some of entertainment's most recognizable names.

About Acast

Acast is the global authority on podcasting, building the infrastructure that serves as the single point of entry for the whole industry. This enables creators to grow and monetize across audio, video, social, and beyond, and brands to buy at scale - without walls or borders. As the world's largest pure-play podcast company, we connect 140,000+ storytellers with 4,000+ advertisers globally. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (ACAST).

releases.title: NETWORK MEDIA GROUP ANNOUNCES LAUNCH OF NETWORK VERTICALS
releases.body:
New division launches in Fall 2026 to develop premium vertical short-form content; one of the fastest-growing new formats in global entertainment

VANCOUVER, BC, Sept. 8, 2026 /CNW/ -- Network Media Group Inc. (TSXV: NTE) (OTC: NETWF) ("Network" or the "Company") is pleased to announce the launch of Network Verticals, a new division of Network Entertainment dedicated to developing, producing, and distributing premium vertical content.

Verticals are feature-length stories serialized into short episodes, typically 50 to 100 episodes, each 60 to 90 seconds. The stories are filmed in a 9:16 aspect ratio designed specifically for smartphone viewing. The genre is known for its scripted dramas and soap opera-like content and is now expanding into other genres, including unscripted true crime, comedy, music, horror, and sports.

Network Verticals marks the Company's entry into one of the fastest-growing formats in digital entertainment. Omdia, a global technology, media, and telecommunications research firm, estimates that the global vertical content market generated US$11 billion in revenue in 2025 and will reach US$14 billion by the end of 2026, with Variety projecting US$26 billion by 2030.

"Verticals are exploding because they meet the evolving needs of today's audiences, delivering short-form content to their cell phones," said Network's Chief Operating Officer, Paul Gertz. "What makes the opportunity particularly compelling is the format's strong monetization potential, with subscription and transactional revenue already growing at an exponential rate. As the business evolves to include advertising, franchises, and new distribution models, we see significant potential for premium storytelling and new revenue opportunities in this space."

Network's Vice President of Studios, Eric MacDonald, said, "Network has a long history of adapting premium storytelling to new platforms and emerging formats. We were one of a select group of production companies chosen to create original content for the innovative but short-lived mobile platform Quibi, conceived by Jeffrey Katzenberg and launched at the outset of the COVID-19 pandemic, which gave us an early opportunity to leverage our premium production experience to short-form, mobile-first storytelling."

Industry leaders are moving quickly into the space. Fox Entertainment has taken an equity stake in Holywater, the company behind the My Drama app, and committed to more than 200 shows for the platform. Disney+ has launched Verts, a dedicated vertical video feed inside its mobile app, while Netflix, Peacock, YouTube, Amazon, and TikTok are all investing in vertical storytelling as both a standalone content category and a tool for audience engagement.

Hollywood talent is following the momentum. Academy Award nominee James Franco, Jimmy Fallon, Kevin Hart, Issa Rae, and Kim Kardashian are among the high-profile talent who have entered the vertical space as producers, developers, on-screen talent, and investors.

"Verticals represent one of the most significant shifts we've seen in how audiences now regularly discover and consume content," said Derik Murray, Network's Founder and CEO. "We've consistently earned the trust of the world's A-list talent, high-profile IP holders, and global distributors, streamers, and broadcasters, and Network Verticals gives us the opportunity to bring that expertise to an evolving format and a new generation of audiences."

Network Verticals will operate as a dedicated content pipeline within the Company. Additional details will be announced in the coming weeks.

About Network Entertainment

Network Media Group is the parent company of Network Entertainment Inc.

Network Entertainment is a creatively driven production company that creates, finances, and produces award-winning film, television and digital content for audiences around the world. For more than two decades, Network has built a reputation for telling the stories of extraordinary and iconic international figures. 

Network has earned international recognition for productions including Facing Ali, which was shortlisted for an Academy Award for Best Feature Documentary; Sidney, which premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival, was produced in partnership with Oprah Winfrey and was released globally on Apple TV+, earning a Critics' Choice Documentary Award for Best Biographical Documentary, and a Black Reel Award for Outstanding Documentary Feature; and Sly Lives! (aka The Burden of Black Genius), a Peabody Award-winning and Emmy Award-nominated feature documentary, directed by Academy Award winner Ahmir "Questlove" Thompson. The film debuted at the 2025 Sundance Film Festival and premiered shortly after on Hulu/Disney+. Another recent release, BRATS, a feature documentary directed by Brat Pack member Andrew McCarthy in partnership with NEON and ABC News Studios, had its world premiere at the 2024 Tribeca Film Festival, went straight to #1 on Hulu upon its release, and won the 2025 ASCAP Award in the Top Streaming Film category.

releases.body:
Benefit concert at Nashville Palace featuring Collin Raye, Allie Colleen and more will support ARC's work

NASHVILLE, Tenn., Sept. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Animal Rescue Corps (ARC), a national nonprofit animal protection organization, is inviting animal advocates and country music fans out for a night of live music Sept. 27 at the Nashville Palace, with every ticket sold helping ARC save another life.

ARC's Night at the Palace will feature performances by country music artists Collin Raye, Allie Colleen, Natalie Murphy, Angie K and Bobby Messano. Doors open at 6 p.m., and music begins at 6:30 p.m.

Proceeds from the evening will help ARC respond when animals are in need, whether that means getting a rescue team on the road, covering veterinary care or providing food and shelter for animals recovering at ARC's Rescue Center outside Nashville.

"When animals need us, we go," said Tim Woodward, executive director of Animal Rescue Corps. "That's the promise we've made. This event gives people a chance to have fun while raising critical funds, and help us keep saying 'yes' when animals have nowhere else to turn. Every person who comes out to enjoy these amazing artists is helping make another rescue possible."

ARC often steps in when local communities are facing cruelty cases or animal emergencies that are simply too large to handle alone. The organization provides the additional support and expertise needed to bring animals to safety and begin their recovery.

"There's a lot of heart in Music City," Woodward said. "You see it in the people who show up for animals, and you see it in the artists who are willing to lend their time and talent to a cause they believe in. This night is really about bringing all of those gifts together. We spend so much time focused on the work in front of us that it's nice to have a night where we celebrate what this community makes possible."

ARC's Night at the Palace will be held at the Nashville Palace, 2611 McGavock Pike in Nashville.

General admission tickets are $65 in advance and $75 the day of the show. Rail seat tickets are $75 in advance and $85 the day of the show. VIP table seat tickets are $150 and include seating on the dance floor and a swag bag. To purchase tickets, visit outhousetickets.com/events/nashville-palace-arc-09272026/tickets.

More information about ARC's work and how to support its ongoing rescue efforts is available at animalrescuecorps.org/.

About Animal Rescue Corps

Since 2010, Animal Rescue Corps (ARC), a national animal protection nonprofit organization, has provided large-scale animal rescue for communities that lack resources to address abuse. In addition to emergency rescue, ARC offers education and shelter relief. releases.title: ON HER BIRTHDAY, BEYONCÉ MAKES A $2 MILLION GIFT TO THE STUDIO MUSEUM IN HARLEM
releases.body:
THE LANDMARK NEW YORK CITY CULTURAL INSTITUTION HAS CHAMPIONED THE WORK OF ARTISTS OF AFRICAN DESCENT FOR NEARLY 60 YEARS

HARLEM, N.Y., Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- To mark her birthday today, global entertainer, entrepreneur and art collector, Beyoncé, makes a $2 million gift to the renowned Studio Museum in Harlem. Founded in 1968, the New York City cultural institution is the nexus for artists of African descent locally, nationally, and internationally and for work that has been inspired and influenced by Black culture. Beyoncé has long been an art collector and a true fan of the Museum's mission of promoting multiple generations of artists of the African diaspora. 

"Art tells all our stories; the past and the present, but is not always accessible to everyone," says Beyoncé. "I have always been impressed with the Studio Museum in Harlem because of its intention to make the museum an integral part of the community. I have been introduced to several of my favorite young and upcoming Black artists through exhibits at the Museum. It is a place of inspiration where all audiences can discover new stories through the canvases of diverse storytellers that reflect our humanity."

Thelma Golden, Ford Foundation Director and Chief Curator of the Studio Museum in Harlem, said, "I am deeply grateful to Beyoncé, both for the generosity of this gift, especially on her birthday, and for recognizing the vital role that the Studio Museum plays in people's lives. Our institution was founded to shift the arts landscape and reimagine who that landscape serves. This gift will allow us to continue strengthening our work for Harlemites, New Yorkers, and audiences across the globe." 

About the Studio Museum in Harlem

Founded in 1968 by a diverse group of artists, community activists, and philanthropists, the Studio Museum in Harlem is internationally known for its catalytic role in promoting the work of artists of African descent. The Studio Museum's new home, situated at its longtime location on West 125th Street, opened to the public on November 15, 2025. Designed by Adjaye Associates with Cooper Robertson serving as executive architect, the building—the first created expressly for the institution's program—enables the Studio Museum to better serve a growing and diverse audience, provide additional educational opportunities for people of all ages, expand its program of world-renowned exhibitions, effectively display its singular collection, and strengthen its trailblazing Artist-in-Residence program.

For more information, visit studiomuseum.org.

Visitor Information 

The Studio Museum in Harlem is located at 144 West 125th Street, between Malcolm X Boulevard (Lenox Avenue) and Adam Clayton Powell Boulevard (Seventh Avenue). 

The Studio Museum is open Wednesday through Sunday, from 11:00 am to 6:00 pm, with extended hours on Friday, from 11:00 am to 9:00 pm.

The Museum is open to Members on Saturday mornings, from 10:00 to 11:00 am, before the galleries open to the public.

Admission rates are offered as a suggestion, with Sundays free for everyone. Suggested rates are $16 for adults and $9 for seniors (sixty-five years and over), students, and visitors with disabilities (care partners are free). Admission is free for children sixteen and under. 

Tickets to the Studio Museum may be purchased online at studiomuseum.org/visit or at the Museum.

releases.title: Korein Tillery Files Lawsuit on Behalf of Music Artists Against AI Music-Generation Platform Suno
releases.body:
Lawsuit alleges Suno built a name-indexed music platform that commercially exploits musicians' identities without consent, seeks to protect musicians' rights in the age of AI

CHICAGO, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Korein Tillery has filed a new lawsuit in the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts. The lawsuit is filed on behalf of acclaimed musician Jason Isbell and other music artists representing a proposed class of similarly situated musicians whose identities have been appropriated and commercially exploited without consent by AI music-generation platform Suno, Inc. The lawsuit asserts claims under a number of state right-of-publicity laws and the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act.

The case, Jason Isbell, et al. v. Suno, Inc., alleges that Suno designed, trained, and commercially deployed a platform built to retrieve musicians by name and provide a multi-media experience evoking those musicians' identities on command. The complaint includes dozens of demonstrations and exhibits of Suno providing—based on musicians' names alone—songs like one the named musician might make, descriptions of the musicians' attributes, and related images (e.g. a white glove for the artist Michael Jackson). According to the complaint, Suno provides these outputs for musicians whose talents span blues, rock, country, alternative, reggaeton, rap, pop, salsa, Hawaiian, ska punk, and alt-country-punk fusion. 

The lawsuit also alleges that Suno, without consent, created and stored voiceprints indexed by name when training its AI on musicians' voices.

"Despite its assertions that Suno did not train its AI on specific musicians' identities and does not allow artists' names as prompts, its own public-facing product shows otherwise," said George A. Zelcs, Partner at Korein Tillery. "Further, Suno's own licensing agreements with major music companies expressly recognize that a copyright license does not supply the separate consent required from the human creators whose identities have been commercially exploited. It's time for musicians to have a seat at the table. We will work vigorously to protect their right to control the use of their own identities." 

The Korein Tillery legal team on this matter includes George A. Zelcs, Audrey L. C. Austin, Marc Wallenstein, and Lucy Prather.

About Korein Tillery

Korein Tillery is an AV-rated, award-winning law firm with offices in St. Louis, Chicago, and Naples. The firm has recovered billions of dollars in verdicts and settlements by aggressively pursuing complex civil cases. Korein Tillery has been named by the National Law Journal as one of the nation's top plaintiffs' law firms.

releases.title: Come Talk To ME, Featuring AI-Recreated Voice, Selected for Twin Cities Film Fest
releases.body:
Documentary brings Parkinson's conversations to film festivals and communities

MINNEAPOLIS, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Come Talk To ME, the feature-length (76 min) documentary by independent filmmaker and director Deacon Warner and first-time producer Jackie Hunt Christensen, has been selected to be part of the Twin Cities Film Fest, Oct. 15-24. The film is also currently available for community screenings worldwide through Kinema, a streaming platform that allows groups to license the film for both in-person and virtual screenings.

Come Talk To ME follows Parkinson's disease (PD) activist Jackie Hunt Christensen, her husband Paul Christensen, their two sons, and a diverse group of friends with PD. Their stories reflect on the many types of communication that are necessary to participate fully in relationships as the disease progresses.

In a groundbreaking approach, Jackie uses artificial intelligence (AI) to recreate her voice as it sounded two years after her diagnosis in 1998 but before the disease had noticeably impacted her speech. This AI-generated voice, dubbed "JHC2K," asks questions written by Jackie's present-day self and also serves as the film's narrator. 

The documentary offers an intimate look at Jackie and Paul's journey, including reflections from their two now-grown sons on how 28 years of Parkinson's have shaped their family dynamic. It also captures Jackie's behind-the-scenes efforts to produce the film, including a trip to an international summit for Parkinson's support group leaders in Austin, Texas, where she and Paul conducted interviews.

Throughout the production, Jackie and Paul face new challenges, but Jackie remains deeply committed to completing the film and raising awareness about how Parkinson's impacts communication and relationships, particularly affecting care partners.

The filmmakers are especially eager for the film to be viewed in settings that allow post-screening discussions, such as film festivals and community-hosted screenings. "I showed [Come Talk To ME] to a group of 23. Every person in the room shared that it was relevant in their life. Everyone should see this," said screening host Kari Kielblock. 

Viewer Marna Anderson described the film as, "a realistic and beautiful look at a family who is learning to love more deeply through a painful and difficult disease. It also provided excellent information and resources for viewers."

Screening Details:

Come Talk TO ME screens at 12 pm on October 24 at Edina Mann Theatre (3911 W. 50th St.

Edina, MN 55424) as part of the Twin Cities Film Fest, which runs Oct 15-24. The Twin Cities Film Fest is headquartered at Marcus West End Cinema, 1625 Park Place Blvd., St. Louis Park, MN 55416.

Anyone interested in hosting a screening of Come Talk To ME can do so directly through the film's Kinema page. Prospective hosts can also contact the film's director: director@cometalktomefilm.com

Visit the film's website to learn more about the film, find Parkinson's disease resources as well as find information about hosting a screening: cometalktomefilm.com

About the Filmmakers

Producer Jackie Hunt Christensen became a Parkinson's disease activist when she was diagnosed with the disease. She has published two guide books on the disease, The First Year---Parkinson's Disease: An Essential Guide for the Newly Diagnosed (2005) and Life With a Battery-Operated Brain: A Patient's Guide to Deep Brain Stimulation Surgery for Parkinson's Disease (2009).

At the time she was diagnosed at 34, Jackie was Co-Director of the Food and Health program at the Institute for Agriculture & Trade Policy in Minneapolis, Minnesota, as well as a co-founder and Co-Director of Health Care Without Harm (HCWH): The Campaign for Environmentally Responsible Health Care. She continued working for both organizations until June 2004, when, at age 40, her PD symptoms forced her to leave her jobs and apply for disability benefits.

Director Deacon Warner is a documentary filmmaker and youth media instructor. He has been teaching media arts since 2008. As an independent filmmaker, Deacon has directed numerous short documentaries including Bee-Sharp Honeybee, Literacy for Freedom: Empowering Black Boys in MN and Every Day Is a Parade. Deacon's first feature documentary, The Co-op Wars, premiered at the Minneapolis St Paul International Film Festival in 2021.

With music from Fraggle Rock, Labyrinth, Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas, and more, this special tribute will be performed on two nights only: Thursday, September 24th, and Friday, September 25th, as part of Museum of Moving Image's celebration of Jim Henson's 90th birthday. Tickets are available now at movingimage.org, and MoMI members receive discounted tickets.

From The Jim Henson Company and Heather Henson, "Jim Henson's Harmonious Hoopla" stars Henson performers Jordan Brownlee (television: Slumberkins; stage: Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas), Aymee Garcia (television: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock; stage: Wicked, Into the Woods), and Leslie Carrara-Rudolph (television: Muppets Tonight, stage: Puppet Up!, Wake Up Your Weird) as they perform memorable and iconic songs from the legacy of Jim Henson with a live band, puppets from Jim Henson's Creature Shop, and a lot of fun. With songs from Jim Henson's best-known films, as well as the theme songs and favorites from his television classics, and with a few surprises along the way, it is sure to be a joyful evening for fans of all ages that is not to be missed.

"Jim Henson's Harmonious Hoopla" is from The Jim Henson Company and Heather Henson. The show is directed by John Tartaglia (television: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock; stage: Avenue Q, Shrek the Musical) and produced by Brenna Ross (stage: Ajijaak on Turtle Island, Green Feather Foundation), with musical direction from Paul Rudolph (television: Sesame Street, Julie's Greenroom).

About The Jim Henson Company

The Jim Henson Company has remained an established leader in family entertainment for over 70 years and is recognized as an innovator in puppetry, animatronics, and digital animation. The Company's most recent credits include the Amazon Kids+ series Jim Henson's Monster Dance, the PBS KIDS special Wowsabout, the hit holiday special for Apple TV The First Snow of Fraggle Rock, and the Emmy-nominated Alexander and the Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Road Trip for Disney+, as well as the Oscar®-winning Guillermo Del Toro's Pinocchio for Netflix, and the Emmy®-winning Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock for Apple TV. Other television credits include Slumberkins and Harriet the Spy for Apple TV; Dinosaur Train, Splash and Bubbles, and Sid the Science Kid all for PBS; Earth to Ned for Disney+; and the Netflix series Word Party and the Emmy-winning The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance. Iconic catalogue titles include Fraggle Rock, The Storyteller, Farscape, and the ground-breaking fantasy classics The Dark Crystal and Labyrinth.

Headquartered in Los Angeles with additional locations in New York and London, the Company is also home to Jim Henson's Creature Shop™, a pre-eminent puppet and creature-building group and industry leader in puppeteered digital animation, with international film, television, theme park, and advertising clients.

About Heather Henson

Heather Henson is a producer, puppet artist, and creative steward whose work centers on connection—to one another, to the natural world, and to the sense of wonder she grew up with through the Muppets. Through the Green Feather Foundation, she creates environmental puppet theater and fosters independent artists through Handmade Puppet Dreams, the Puppet Slam Network, and the Jim Henson Carriage House, where new puppet works are developed in collaboration with the Jim Henson Foundation. Her philanthropic and investment work supports Indigenous communities, environmental stewardship, regenerative initiatives, and creative projects that help build a more connected and sustainable world. Heather is President of the Jane Henson Foundation, Chair of the Jim Henson Legacy, and a shareholder and board member of The Jim Henson Company.

releases.title: Ric Burns' Acclaimed NEW YORK: A DOCUMENTARY FILM Returns with Two New Films September 21st and 22nd On PBS
releases.body:
Shadows of the Past and The Future of Cities explore decades of challenge, growth and change across the late 20 th and early 21 st centuries

NEW YORK, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- New York: A Documentary Film, the acclaimed series produced by Steeplechase Films and directed by Ric Burns and written by Burns and James Sanders, returns with two new films premiering Monday, September 21 and Tuesday, September 22 at 9pm on PBS (check local listings), pbs.org and the PBS App. Presenting a vivid portrait of New York's evolution and transformation over the last half-century, Shadows of the Past and The Future of Cities chronicle the story of America's largest city across more than 50 years of challenge, growth, and change. Shadows of the Past and The Future of Cities are featured as part of The WNET Group's The Story of New York collection exploring the stories and history that built New York City and the extraordinary people who continue to inspire the future of this world hub.

Shadows of the Past, explores the forces that shaped the city in the second half of the 20th century, as New York plunged into the most threatening period of decline and disorder in its history—only to rise again, thanks to a stunning drop in crime, to regain its place at the vanguard of world cities. The episode concludes in the summer of 2001, with New York, now remarkably safe and secure, unaware that a new threat from beyond its borders would soon threaten to undo all the progress of the previous decade.

The Future of Cities begins just after 9/11 and follows New York's efforts to recover under the new and untested mayoralty of Michael R. Bloomberg. Through rare archival footage and compelling interviews, the episode traces the aftermath of 9/11, the financial crisis of 2008, Superstorm Sandy in 2012 and the COVID-19 pandemic of 2020. Yet defying the doomsayers, the city also rebuilt itself in these years on a dramatic scale—economically, physically, and demographically—thanks to an astonishing influx of newcomers from around the world. The episode ends with the inauguration of Zohran Mamdani as mayor of New York in January of 2026.

Narrated by Tony Award-winning actor Robert Sean Leonard, and featuring an original score by Emmy Award-winning composer Brian Keane, Shadows of the Past and The Future of Cities are presented in high-definition 4K video and sound, and feature a combination of original cinematography, archival footage, still photography and interviews with leaders in government, academia and journalism. Featured interviewees include four former New York City mayors David Dinkins, Michael R. Bloomberg, Bill de Blasio and Eric Adams; New York-Presbyterian President (Emeritus) Dr. Steven Corwin; The New Yorker's Adam Gopnik; Columbia University Professor Kenneth Jackson; The New York Times' Wesley Morris, Michael Kimmelman and Dodai Stewart; New York magazine's Justin Davidson; Fordham University Professor Christina Greer; architect and urbanist Vishaan Chakrabarti; PBS journalist Ray Suarez; New York University Professor Suketu Mehta; and The New York Times columnist and a co-anchor of CNBC's Squawk Box Andrew Ross Sorkin; and Social Activist Claudia Romo Edelman.

"New York City has been the supreme laboratory of modern life for four hundred years now," said Burns. "It's an astonishing vortex of capitalism and democracy, innovation and change, openness and toleration, that more than any other city on earth has made itself home to all the peoples of the world. Its story over the past fifty years has been one of almost constant challenge and self-reinvention—and a testimony to the extraordinary resilience and boundless collective energies that have kept it at the forefront of world culture. We're thrilled to welcome viewers back for these amazing recent chapters in the city's history." 

"It has been a gratifying experience to bring our series up to the present day with these new episodes," said Sanders, the Emmy Award-winning co-writer and co-producer of the new films. "Not only are there so many compelling stories to tell about the city's last half-century—some surprisingly little-known—but many of the greatest themes of the original eight episodes—immigration, globalization, the city's astonishing capacity for economic and physical reinvention—have powerfully reasserted themselves in recent decades—often at a scale and with a force never before seen, even in the city's long history."   

The original eight-part, 17½-hour series—tracing the history of the city across four hundred years, since its founding by the Dutch in 1624—was the recipient of two Emmy Awards, four additional Emmy nominations, the CINE Golden Eagle, and the Alfred I. duPont-Columbia University award, and became one of the most-watched presentations in public television history. A revised edition of the series' bestselling companion volume, New York: An Illustrated History, published by Alfred A. Knopf, features two new chapters corresponding to the new episodes, along with contributions by Adam Gopnik, Ester Fuchs, and Suketu Mehta, all of whom appear in these new films. 

A production of Steeplechase Films, Inc. in association with The WNET Group for PBS, in association with Lismore Road and Artemis Rising Foundation, New York: A Documentary Film – Shadows of the Past and The Future of Cities are directed by Ric Burns, written by James Sanders and Ric Burns, and produced by Leigh Howell, Bonnie Lafave and James Sanders. Executive Producers are John Moore, Margaret Munzer Loeb, Geralyn White Dreyfous, Jana Edelbaum and Regina K. Scully. The films are narrated by Robert Sean Leonard, edited by Parker Dixon (with Chih Hsuan Liang, Omry Maoz, Margaret Metzger, Tom Patterson, Joshua Woltermann, Michael Craft and Li-Shin Yu), with cinematography by Buddy Squires ASC and music by Brian Keane. For The WNET Group, Stephen Segaller is executive in charge and Benjamin Phelps is senior producer. The films are part of the New York: A Documentary Film series originally developed with American Experience/GBH.

Corporate funding for New York: A Documentary Film – Shadows of the Past and The Future of Cities was provided by Hudson River Trading. Major funding was provided by the American Express Foundation, Simons Foundation, The Rosalind P. Walter Foundation, Google.org through the Tides Foundation, the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, the Estate of Roland Karlen, Elaine and W. Weldon Wilson, and The Rockefeller Foundation. Support was also provided by Angela and Robert Kissane, the Ford Foundation / JustFilms, Roger and Susan Hertog, the Henry Luce Foundation, the Carson Family Charitable Trust, The Overbrook Foundation, Arthur G. Altshul, Jr. and Rula Jebreal, and by the following individuals and institutions: Fiona and Eric Rudin, Agnes Gund, Howard Morgan, The Burton P. & Judith B. Resnick Foundation, Anheuser-Busch InBev, Mr. & Mrs. Peter L. Malkin, Leon and Toby Cooperman, The Schwartz Family Foundation, Jessica & Jerry Seinfeld, the May and Samuel Rudin Family Foundation, The Walentas Family Foundation, the Gorman Family, Richard K. DeScherer, Nathalie Kaplan & David Einhorn, Marcie Pantzer, Susie Lopez, Ellin & Ron Delsener, Amy Cappellazzo & Joanne Rosen, Wendy Chaikin, Jonathan Haidt & Jayne Riew, and by public television viewers.

The WNET Group creates inspiring media content and meaningful experiences for diverse audiences nationwide. It is the community-supported home of New York's THIRTEEN – America's flagship PBS station – WLIW, THIRTEEN PBS KIDS, THIRTEEN WORLD and WLIW Create; Long Island's only NPR station WLIW-FM; ALL ARTS, the arts and culture media provider; newsroom NJ Spotlight News; and FAST channel PBS Nature. Through these channels and streaming platforms, The WNET Group brings arts, culture, education, news, documentary, entertainment, and DIY programming to more than five million viewers each month. The WNET Group's award-winning productions include signature PBS series Nature, Great Performances, American Masters, and Amanpour and Company and trusted local news programs like NJ Spotlight News with Briana Vannozzi. Inspiring curiosity and nurturing dreams, The WNET Group's award-winning Kids' Media and Education team produces the PBS KIDS series Cyberchase, interactive Mission US history games, and resources for families, teachers and caregivers. A leading nonprofit public media producer for more than 60 years, The WNET Group presents and distributes content that fosters lifelong learning, including initiatives addressing poverty, jobs, economic opportunity, social justice, understanding, and the environment. Through Passport, station members can stream new and archival programming anytime, anywhere. The WNET Group represents the best in public media. Join us.

releases.title: VIENDOMOVIES CELEBRATES 20 YEARS PROGRAMMING THE BEST SPANISH-LANGUAGE CINEMA
releases.body:
MIAMI, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ViendoMovies, the Spanish–language PayTV channel owned by SOMOSTV (a company chaired by Luis Villanueva and part of SOMOS Group), which programs the best contemporary films produced in Spanish, 24 hours a day and without commercial interruptions, celebrates during the month of September 2026 the twentieth (20th) anniversary of a space that showcases and promotes the cinema that has impacted audiences around the world. ViendoMovies commemorates an outstanding trajectory in Spanish–language television in the United States and Puerto Rico presenting modern and exclusive films, originally produced in Spanish, with high production values, big–screen quality, and the most popular talent from all Spanish–speaking countries. The channel is included in the Hispanic channel packages of major cable and telecommunications companies, strengthening entertainment offerings for the Latino community.

ViendoMovies was launched on September 5, 2006, with a premium profile, elegant on–air presence, and a high–quality graphic package. The channel programs films in High Definition and first–window PayTV releases, not available on other channels or platforms—an important option in times of redundancy in title distribution. With its extensive library, the channel offers, in addition to regular premieres, genre or talent cycles, functioning as a promotional space for modern Spanish–language cinema.

ViendoMovies includes closed captioning in English and Spanish and coverage of events where Spanish–language cinema participates, such as the Oscars, Goya Awards, Ariel Awards, and festivals in Huelva, San Sebastián, Miami, Chicago, and others. The channel includes a significant offering of Video On Demand (VOD) titles, allowing subscribers to enjoy great films whenever they choose.

Before the arrival of ViendoMovies, Spanish–language cinema had limited representation in the market, despite the production capacity of countries with well–developed film industries such as Colombia, Chile, Peru, the Dominican Republic, Argentina, and Spain, among others. The cinema from these countries on the channel, combined with the significant presence of Mexican cinema (for the largest Latino community), provides a balanced offering of origins and genres and represents an important source of revenue for the Spanish–language film industry, supporting its growth and sustainability.

ViendoMovies celebrates national holidays and U.S. festivities, fostering integration and meeting the needs of a community that goes to the movies an average of 3.3 times a year—compared to Asians (2.9) and Whites (2.3)—and represents 24% of box office sales despite being 19% of the population.

Luis Villanueva, President and CEO of SOMOS Group, stated: "Twenty years in such a competitive and dynamic market is an achievement worthy of celebration. Our team established a position that is a source of pride for us, our clients, and our audience. We deliver a channel of the highest quality, competitive with the best, in the most developed television market. Cinema is one of the entertainment options most preferred by Latinos, and with ViendoMovies we enjoy modern productions representative of a cutting–edge industry. We will continue this important mission, which connects us with our roots and language."

ViendoMovies celebrates more than an anniversary. These are 20 years of permanence, evolution, and connection with its audience as a destination to enjoy the best films originally produced in Spanish. The channel also celebrates Hispanic Heritage Month, from September 15 to October 15, along with the celebration of Mexico's Independence Day (September 16), featuring productions from that country throughout the day.

ABOUT VIENDOMOVIES: ViendoMovies is a premium Spanish–language PayTV channel programming exclusive contemporary cinema in Spanish, without commercial interruptions, 24 hours a day, in a culturally relevant premium package. ViendoMovies is produced for the Hispanic market in the United States and Puerto Rico and is part of SOMOSTV LLC. For more information, visit http://www.viendomovies.com and https://www.somostv.com

Contact: José Antonio Espinal, jespinal@somostv.net

SHENZHEN, China, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hollyland, a leading provider of wireless products for professional film and video production, and content creation, today announced the Pyro 7 Ultra, a professional all-in-one 7-inch wireless monitor that integrates robust wireless connectivity and professional-grade monitoring into a single, highly portable device. Built for cinematographers, directors, camera operators, DITs, and focus pullers, the Pyro 7 Ultra delivers broadcast-grade color accuracy alongside robust, long-range, and low-latency wireless video transmission. It simplifies camera-top monitoring, wireless focus pulling, and mobile director monitoring, reducing setup complexity and enabling a more efficient production workflow.

Jay Sun, Product Manager at Hollyland stated, "For professional productions, an accurate monitor is essential because every department needs a reliable visual reference on set. Even minor color differences can affect decisions and create problems later in post-production. With Pyro 7 Ultra's QD-LCD technology, crews can trust what they see during production with professional-grade color accuracy".

Pre-Calibrated Display with Broadcast-Grade Color Accuracy

At the heart of the Pyro 7 Ultra is a premium QD-LCD display that delivers broadcast-grade color quality and consistency required for professional productions.

Each monitor is Calman® pre-calibrated to achieve a ΔE <1.5, ensuring highly accurate color reproduction directly out of the box. The display offers 99% Rec.709 and 95% DCI-P3 color gamut, Gamma 2.4, and up to 1,500 nits of brightness, providing dependable monitoring even in bright environments.

For long-term consistency, users can quickly recalibrate the display using the Hollyland Color Calibrator holistic solution that doesn't require a PC or third-party calibration hardware.

HDMI and SDI interfaces support loop-through and cross-output. Camera control is supported on select camera models from Sony, Canon, Nikon, and ARRI, with responsive control of functions including shutter, aperture, ISO, white balance, and more.

Robust Wireless Performance with TWiFi

Powered by Hollyland's proprietary Twin-WiFi (TWiFi) technology, the Pyro 7 Ultra simultaneously utilizes two wireless bands to create a resilient dual-path connection. Automatic frequency hopping minimizes interference in congested RF environments, maintaining a stable connection.

The system enables wireless video transmission at ranges of up to 1 km (3,300 feet), with latency as low as 20 ms in Focus Mode. It also supports 4K60 video transmission via one transmitter to an unlimited number of receivers, making it ideal for productions requiring multiple monitoring positions.

Professional Monitoring with HollyOS

The Pyro 7 Ultra introduces HollyOS, Hollyland's next-generation operating system designed for fast-paced production environments. The intuitive interface offers direct display controls, customizable monitoring layouts, and an extensive range of professional image analysis tools.

A Unified Ecosystem for Multi-Camera Productions

Unlike standalone wireless monitoring solutions, the Pyro 7 Ultra is designed as part of Hollyland's broader Pyro ecosystem. It pairs with compatible Pyro transmitters, receivers, and monitors, allowing production teams to expand or reconfigure wireless monitoring workflows without interoperability concerns or production delays. The result is a reliable, flexible, and scalable system that adapts easily to productions of any size.

Pricing and Availability

The Hollyland Pyro 7 Ultra is available now through authorized Hollyland distributors, Amazon, and the Hollyland online store for $1,399 USD.

For more information, visit: https://www.hollyland.com/product/pyro-7-ultra

About Hollyland

Hollyland is a leading provider of wireless products specializing in wireless intercom systems, video transmission systems, monitors, wireless microphones, and live streaming cameras. Since 2013, Hollyland has served millions of users worldwide across filmmaking, broadcasting, video production, live events, theaters, houses of worship, exhibitions, and content creation. The company operates a global sales network spanning approximately 160 countries and regions, supported by regional teams and offices worldwide. For more information, please visit https://www.hollyland.com/, Hollyland Facebook, and Hollyland Instagram.

releases.title: Independent Psychological Thriller "The Things I Didn't Do" With Full House at Central Florida Premiere
releases.body:
Kling Brothers Entertainment premiere debuted with cast, crew and community supporters to celebrate Central Florida's growing independent film community

ORLANDO, Fla., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Things I Didn't Do, the independent psychological thriller series created by filmmaker Thiago Kling, premiered Saturday, Aug. 8, at Regal Winter Park Village & RPX, welcoming a full-capacity audience for the debut of its pilot.

Presented by Kling Brothers Entertainment in collaboration with the Orlando Film Commission, the premiere brought together the series' cast, crew, filmmakers, media and community supporters for an evening celebrating the years of work behind the production.

Originally conceived in 2015, The Things I Didn't Do was ultimately brought to life in Central Florida, with local talent and production partners contributing to the project on both sides of the camera. The premiere offered an opportunity to recognize that collaborative effort while spotlighting the region's established and emerging film community.

"Having the premiere here in Orlando, surrounded by the people who helped make this project possible, was incredibly rewarding," said Thiago Kling, creator and writer of The Things I Didn't Do. "The response from the audience made the night special for the entire cast and crew. We're proud of what we created together and grateful to everyone who supported us along the way."

Directed by Fernando Tosetti, whose work has earned numerous honors, including Best Director at Campus Movie Fest (2019), Best Editing from Orlando Independent Filmmakers (2021), Best Cinematography from the Organization of Independent Filmmakers (2025), a Silver Telly Award for Videography (2026) and a Best Picture nomination at the Hollywood Florida Film Festival, the series brings together an accomplished creative team. Written by Julia Antuerpem, a former Disney, Globo and Netflix writer, Harvard-trained creative writer and author of award-winning screenplays recognized with more than 60 international honors.

The series follows Ethan, a withdrawn teenager struggling to find his place in the world. To cope with feelings of isolation, Ethan fills a secret notebook with disturbing drawings imagining the deaths of those who have hurt him. When the notebook disappears and the people inside it begin dying exactly as he imagined, Ethan is pulled into a chilling mystery that forces him to question what is real and who can be trusted.

Following its Orlando premiere, The Things I Didn't Do begins its next chapter as the filmmakers explore opportunities to continue production and bring the full series to life for new audiences.

BURBANK, Calif., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CJ 4DPLEX, the world's leading entertainment technology and content company specializing in premium film formats, cinematic production, visual effects and immersive experiences, today announced that Sony Pictures' Spider-Man: Brand New Day has become the highest-grossing film of all time across its SCREENX and 4DX formats, generating more than $104 million in combined global box office.
releases.title: SONY PICTURES' SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY BECOMES CJ 4DPLEX'S HIGHEST-GROSSING FILM OF ALL TIME ACROSS SCREENX AND 4DX
releases.body:
Film sets new all-time CJ 4DPLEX record in just 33 days, drawing more than 6.7 million moviegoers across 1,200 screens with a record 40% average occupancy

BURBANK, Calif., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CJ 4DPLEX, the world's leading entertainment technology and content company specializing in premium film formats, cinematic production, visual effects and immersive experiences, today announced that Sony Pictures' Spider-Man: Brand New Day has become the highest-grossing film of all time across its SCREENX and 4DX formats, generating more than $104 million in combined global box office.

In just 33 days, Spider-Man: Brand New Day surpassed the previous all-time CJ 4DPLEX global box office record established by Avatar: The Way of Water, which accumulated $103 million across its 228-day theatrical run. The unprecedented speed at which Spider-Man: Brand New Day reached the milestone underscores the growing global demand for differentiated premium theatrical experiences and the increasing value SCREENX and 4DX can deliver to filmmakers, studios and exhibitors.

Since its global release, Spider-Man: Brand New Day has drawn more than 6.7 million admissions across SCREENX and 4DX, playing more than 115,000 shows across 1,200 screens worldwide. The film has achieved a record 40% average occupancy rate, demonstrating extraordinary audience demand and the ability of premium formats to drive moviegoers to theaters and maximize the value of every auditorium. It also set opening records for SCREENX in 36 countries and 4DX in 22 countries.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day marked the debut of CJ 4DPLEX's "Shot for SCREENX" initiative and the first time the company collaborated with filmmakers from on-set production through theatrical exhibition. Working alongside director Destin Daniel Cretton and the filmmaking team, SCREENX provided a new creative canvas designed to extend select moments beyond the traditional screen and surround audiences with imagery conceived specifically for the format, moving SCREENX further upstream in the creative process and giving filmmakers new tools to expand the scale and impact of their storytelling.

"The global response to Spider-Man: Brand New Day has been extraordinary," said Steven O'Dell, President, International Marketing & Distribution, Sony Pictures Entertainment. "The success of Shot for SCREENX demonstrates how creative collaboration can enhance the theatrical experience, and we're thrilled to see that innovation resonate with audiences around the world."

"Spider-Man: Brand New Day has achieved something no film has ever done across SCREENX and 4DX, and to establish this record in just 33 days makes the accomplishment even more extraordinary," said Jun Bang, CEO, CJ 4DPLEX. "As the first film in our Shot for SCREENX initiative, it represents an important evolution in how we collaborate with filmmakers and studios. We are incredibly grateful to Sony Pictures, Destin Daniel Cretton and the entire filmmaking team for embracing this new creative approach and helping demonstrate what is possible when premium formats become part of the filmmaking process from the beginning."

"This record demonstrates the tremendous opportunity premium formats create across the theatrical ecosystem," said Don Savant, CEO, CJ 4DPLEX Americas. "For studios and filmmakers, SCREENX and 4DX provide differentiated ways to showcase their biggest films, create excitement and drive incremental box office. For exhibitors, they provide a premium experience audiences actively seek out and are willing to pay more to enjoy. Most importantly, we are incredibly grateful to Sony Pictures for embracing our vision for 'Shot for SCREENX' and working with us to make it a reality. Their partnership and commitment were instrumental in achieving this historic success."

With SCREENX and 4DX now reaching audiences across major theatrical markets worldwide, studios and filmmakers have a powerful global premium platform through which to differentiate major releases, while exhibitors can offer audiences experiences that cannot be replicated at home.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day is now playing in SCREENX and 4DX theaters worldwide.

About Spider-Man: Brand New Day

It's a BRAND NEW DAY for Peter Parker. Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see. The world may have forgotten Peter Parker, but he hasn't forgotten them.

Through continuous innovation, the company is committed to expanding immersive storytelling and creating new ways for audiences around the world to experience cinema.

SCREENX is the world's first multi-projection cinema technology, delivering a 270-degree panoramic viewing experience that extends select scenes beyond the main screen and onto the auditorium walls. By surrounding audiences with exclusive imagery created or specially formatted for SCREENX, the technology enhances immersion while preserving the filmmaker's creative vision.

4DX is the world's leading immersive theatrical technology, enhancing films with synchronized motion seats and more than 21 environmental effects, including wind, water, scent, fog, lightning, vibration and more. releases.title: Dance Legends Armin van Buuren and Laidback Luke Join Moises to Build Responsible AI Tools for Musicians
releases.body:
Electronic pioneers will help shape new DJ and producer workflows for the creative suite used by 80 million musicians

SALT LAKE CITY, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Moises, the creative suite for musicians, today announced that Armin van Buuren and Laidback Luke have joined the company as the first members of its Artist Partnerships program. Both artists will help shape new producer- and DJ-focused features and contribute to conversations about the future of music technology and responsible AI. The new program follows the appointment of Charlie Puth as Moises' Chief Music Officer and expands the company's effort to put working artists at the center of how its creative tools are built.

At a time when generative AI is raising questions around consent, ownership, and replacement, Moises is taking a different approach: rather than generating finished songs from prompts, its creative suite helps musicians practice, perform, and create while keeping artistic decision-making in their hands. The company trains its AI models only on licensed and authorized content.

"Electronic music has always moved forward because artists were willing to experiment with new technology," said Geraldo Ramos, founder and CEO of Moises. "The next generation of creative tools has to be built with musicians, not around them. Armin and Luke understand the craft, the community, and the responsibility that comes with building tools musicians will actually use."

Architects of Modern Dance Music

For more than two decades, van Buuren has shaped the sound, culture, and worldwide reach of electronic music. One of only three artists to be named the world's No. 1 DJ by DJ Mag five times, he is a GRAMMY-nominated artist, co-founder of Armada Music, and host of A State of Trance, the radio show that reaches more than 40 million listeners.

"Technology has always been part of how electronic music evolves," said van Buuren. "What matters is whether the artist stays in control. Moises approaches AI with respect for the musician's own sound and decision-making, and I'm excited to help build tools that make producers faster and more expressive without taking the creativity out of their hands."

Laidback Luke is a DJ, producer, label founder, and educator whose influence helped shape the rise of modern EDM. Through Mixmash Records, his production forums, and masterclasses, he has championed emerging artists including Avicii and Afrojack. His collaboration and remix credits include Daft Punk, Kanye West, Rihanna, Madonna, Jay-Z, Pharrell, and others.

"Every generation of producers gets new tools, but the best tools do not do the work for you," said Laidback Luke. "They help you hear more, learn faster, and make stronger creative decisions. That is the kind of AI I want young producers to grow up with."

What Comes Next

Moises chose dance music as the starting point for the program because electronic artists have long been among the first to transform new technology into new forms of musical expression. Over the coming months, the company plans to announce additional high-profile artists and producers across multiple genres.

The program builds on the company's recent industry partnerships, including Fender, which selected Moises as the first AI technology partner for its Studio Pro DAW, and Ableton, which chose Moises' stem-separation technology for Ableton Live. Moises has also partnered with Blackstar Amps, the Whitney Houston Estate, and Cory Henry.

Learn more: https://moises.ai 

About Moises

Moises is the creative suite used by 80 million musicians worldwide. The platform gives everyone from hobbyists to world-class artists studio-level tools to practice, perform, create, and collaborate across mobile, desktop, and web. Powered by more than 50 proprietary AI models, Moises processes nearly six years' worth of audio every day and delivers capabilities including stem separation, songwriting and production tools, audio enhancement, and performance recording. Built by a global team with experience at Spotify, Pandora and TikTok, Moises was named Apple's 2024 iPad App of the Year and is available worldwide in 33 languages.

releases.title: SOCAN is Standing Up for Music Creators and Publishers with Legal Action Against Suno Inc. for Unauthorized Use of Music in Generative AI Platform
releases.body:
Multibillion- dollar platform is publicly streaming AI‑generated outputs that replicate songs in SOCAN's repertoire without consent or compensation

TORONTO, Sept. 2, 2026 /CNW/ -- SOCAN has filed a lawsuit against Suno Inc., alleging that the company's generative AI platform is producing and streaming outputs that replicate human-created musical works without consent or payment, and as a result has infringed the performing rights in musical works in SOCAN's repertoire.

"SOCAN has a responsibility to act when the rights of music creators and publishers are put at risk. The evidence shows that the Suno platform has generated and streamed outputs that copy works in our repertoire, and that cannot go unchallenged," said Jennifer Brown, SOCAN CEO. "Innovation can't come at the expense of human creativity. The future of music must belong to the people who make it."

Suno has built its business by training its generative AI models on virtually all music files readily accessible on the Internet, without obtaining the necessary permissions or licences. SOCAN has identified Suno outputs that are identical or similar to songs in SOCAN's repertoire and have been generated and streamed without consent or compensation.

SOCAN's legal action is a necessary and proactive step to ensure that human music creation is valued, respected, and compensated.

Allegations of infringement

SOCAN's claim alleges that, by making the Suno platform available to the public in Canada, using it to generate and make available outputs that replicate songs in SOCAN's repertoire, and streaming those outputs to users in Canada and around the world, Suno has infringed SOCAN's performing rights in the underlying songs. The lawsuit lists a sample of 150 publicly available Suno outputs that SOCAN has identified. SOCAN expects other unauthorized outputs and activities to come to light as the litigation progresses.

"Suno's failure to meet its copyright obligations led us to pursue litigation," said Andrea Kokonis, Chief Legal Officer and General Counsel. "Our evidence is clear, and so is our objective: to establish that AI companies must respect the rights of music creators and publishers. This case is fundamentally about ensuring that long‑standing copyright principles continue to apply in the AI era."

SOCAN's action asserts that AI development must operate within the law and respect the rights of those who make music possible.

SOCAN will not comment on the claim beyond what is in the court record.

For more information visit the SOCAN litigation webpage.

About SOCAN

SOCAN is Canada's largest member-owned music rights organization, championing the fundamental value of music and the people who create it. SOCAN collects license fees for the public performance and reproduction of music, matches them to rights holders, and distributes them as royalties to songwriters, composers and music creators and publishers in Canada and around the world. With more than a century of expertise and innovation, SOCAN stands for respect and fair compensation for creative work – protecting, recognizing, and celebrating its over 200,000 songwriter, composer, and music publisher members. For more information: www.socan.com.

NASHVILLE, Tenn., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Unsigned Only Music Awards is proud to announce the winners of the 2026 competition, recognizing an extraordinary group of independent artists from around the world whose music stood out among thousands of entries.

This year's top honor, Artist of the Year, has been awarded to Artur Menezes for "Once Again." In addition, Unsigned Only has named winners across its diverse range of categories, celebrating outstanding talent in all genres of contemporary music.

Unlike traditional awards programs, Unsigned Only is specifically dedicated to independent and unsigned artists. Winners are selected by a panel of accomplished recording artists, music managers, booking agents, journalists, and other music-industry professionals with extensive experience in their respective fields. For a complete list of judges go to: https://www.unsignedonly.com/judges.

Each winner receives a custom award designed by Society Awards, the company behind high-profile entertainment awards including the Emmy and Golden Globe awards. The Artist of the Year also receives a $20,000 cash prize.

Many past winners of Unsigned Only have gone on to sign major label deals, tour internationally, secure licensing placements, and build successful careers, including: GAYLE, Ingrid Andress, Jordan Adetunji, Gabby Barrett, Coco Jones, Tenille Arts, Faouzia, Jordan St. Cyr, Brett Young, and many more.

Artur Menezes, the Artist of The Year recipient, is a Brazilian-born, Los Angeles-based guitarist, singer, and songwriter. Known for his explosive guitar playing, soulful vocals, and distinctive ability to blend Blues and Rock, Menezes has built an international reputation. His career has taken him from the blues clubs of Chicago to major festivals and stages across the United States, Europe, and South America. He performed at Lollapalooza Brazil 2026 as the only blues rock artist in the lineup. He has shared stages with artists including Buddy Guy, Joe Satriani, Steve Vai, and Christone "Kingfish" Ingram, among others.

Upon learning of his Unsigned Only win, Menezes said, "It's hard to put into words what I'm feeling right now, but one thing I can say is this: besides the art itself, recognition is one of the best things an artist can have. Thank you so much!"

Menezes' accomplishments already include the Blues Foundation's Gibson/Albert King Award for Best Guitarist and appearances on the Experience Hendrix Tour and Eric Clapton's Crossroads Guitar Festival. Guitar Player Magazine selected him one of the 'Top Best 25 New Blues Artists', while Joe Bonamassa singled him out as one of the most exciting modern blues guitarists "who shreds the blues and is not afraid to do that."

"Artur Menezes is the kind of artist Unsigned Only was created to recognize," said Candace Avery and Jim Morgan, founders of Unsigned Only. "His extraordinary musicianship, distinctive voice, and authenticity come through in every note – and his ability to make the guitar speak with such power and emotion is truly remarkable. You can hear the years of dedication in his playing, but you can also hear the joy, passion, and personality behind it."

In addition to Menezes, there is a winner in each of the 24 categories. Hailing from all over the world they range from talented amateurs to seasoned performers. For a complete list of winners, go to: https://www.unsignedonly.com/winners.

As the one-year anniversary of Charlie Kirk's death approaches on September 10, Real America's Music is honoring his memory in a way that goes far beyond a song. "We Miss You, Charlie," will serve as a tribute project built to turn remembrance into action.

One hundred percent of the net profits from the project will be donated to TPUSA and TP Action, supporting the cultural and political causes Charlie cared about most: the next generation of student leaders, and grassroots organizing leading into the heat of the midterm elections.

"One year later, we still feel the weight of Charlie's absence — but we also feel the power of everything he built," said Parker Sigg, Vice President at Real America's Voice, the streaming platform for The Charlie Kirk Show. 'We Miss You, Charlie' is our way of saying that his mission didn't end with him — it's being carried forward, louder than ever, by the millions of people he inspired."
